_comment: Tool schemas exposed by the PaladinFi Swap MCP server at https://swap.paladinfi.com/mcp. This file is informational; the live server is the source of truth.

tools.name: swap_quote
tools.description: Get a competitive multi-aggregator swap quote on Base (chainId 8453). Queries integrated upstream aggregators (currently 0x Settler and Velora AugustusSwapper v6.2; 1inch and Odos planned) and returns ready-to-execute calldata with a 10 bps routing fee already injected. PaladinFi does not represent any returned route as the best available across the broader DeFi market. Your wallet signs and submits the transaction; PaladinFi never holds funds.

sellToken.description: ERC-20 contract address of the token being sold (0x-prefixed).

buyToken.description: ERC-20 contract address of the token being bought (0x-prefixed).

sellAmount.description: Amount of sellToken in wei (integer string).

taker.description: Address that will sign and submit the transaction.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points. Defaults to 50 (0.5%).

tools.name: trust_check_preview
tools.description: Get a SAMPLE-FIXTURE preview of the PaladinFi token-contract trust check. NOT a real evaluation. The response contains a top-level `_real: false` marker, every factor is `real: false`, and the recommendation is prefixed `sample-` (e.g., `sample-allow`). Use this to verify your client constructs valid request payloads and to inspect the response schema. DO NOT use the preview verdict to gate real swaps, signing, or any production agent decision. For real evaluations, POST to /v1/trust-check (x402-paid, $0.001 USDC/call) which consults the live OFAC SDN list (refreshed daily from the Treasury XML feed), GoPlus token security signals, Etherscan source verification, and anomaly heuristics.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID. Defaults to 8453 (Base, currently the only supported chain).

tools.name: swap_health
tools.description: Get current service health, fee configuration, supported chains, per-source counters (0x and Velora), decimals-cache state, last Velora startup-canary verdict, and selector-enforcement state. Returns the same payload as the GET /health endpoint.
